sources.snippet: Early Fusion: Early fusion combines or merges raw or lower-level features from multiple modalities and inputs to jointly model the different modalities. This allows cross-modal inter-action at the early stages of processing, but is often faced with incompatible feature dimensions and noisy inputs.
